mixin:default-on-error.note: The mixin declares no default value for a check to compare.

mixin:errors.note: The mixin documents the errors of the callable.

mixin:integration-only.note: The mixin documents that the callable needs a real dependency.

mixin:runs-until-cancelled.note: The mixin documents that the callable runs until its context ends.

mixin:sample.note: The mixin names the builder of the inputs of each derived call of the callable.

mixin:scope.note: The mixin documents the scope of the callable.

mixin:waits.note: The mixin documents that the callable can wait for another call.

shape:closer.note: A close returns nothing that a check could compare.

shape:composite-writer.note: A write is an input of the other checks, and its result is an error alone.

shape:deleter.note: A delete is an input of the other checks, and its result is an error alone.

shape:lifecycle.note: A lifecycle call returns nothing that a check could compare.

shape:multi-arg-writer.note: A write is an input of the other checks, and its result is an error alone.

shape:mutator.note: A mutation is an input of the other checks, and its result is an error alone.

shape:writer.note: A write is an input of the other checks, and its result is an error alone.
